findings.face: All five forms retain open friendly amber eyes and a small kind smile; the middle expression is recommended.
findings.art: Common frames preserve aspect ratios, aligned labels fit their safe regions. Orange identity and large tail patterns remain readable at actual battle size.

findings.growth: Unique I/II contributions across nodes unlock shared forms; first evolution needs two completed nodes. Full-path and short-path completion screenshots wait for CSS fill to settle. Final bar measures 348.52px of 348.77px inner width, rounding only.
findings.controls: Frame and symbol move together on hover/press; root hit area stays stable. Pointer-out restores the surface. Defense locks remain bright on opaque gold/navy controls; spent symbols and use lights darken.
findings.effects: Shield surrounds the heroine; heart moves to the heroine; strike changes enemy HP. No whole-body animation, morph or warp is used.
findings.preReader: Game cutouts use pictures, counts, locks, pips, HP changes and at most a short title/labels. Reviewed with words hidden and no audio. Reviewer prose stays outside game cutouts.
findings.checks: 34 functional checks pass after final polish; no page errors or write requests. No database/migration dependency. Static hosts remain inside stage and touch targets exceed 44 CSS px.
